description: List your customers' organizations (B2B accounts such as companies, workspaces or teams) in the workspace. The dashboard shows them under Subscribers > Organizations; these tools keep the account names. Not your Sequenzy account, workspace or login: use get_account for that. Search matches name, external ID and domain. Organizations group contacts; their attributes reach every member as `organization.<name>` for segment attribute filters and sequence conditions, and as `{{organization.<name>}}` merge tags (`account.*` is an older alias).

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

search.description: Match name, external ID or domain.

withoutEventRecipients.description: true lists only accounts with members but no owner or admin. Account events go to owners or admins by default, so alerts for these accounts reach nobody until a member gets one of those roles.

name: list_accounts

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_accounts` MCP tool.

accounts.description: Accounts (B2B organizations). Each entry includes id, externalId, name, domain, attributes, memberCount, lastEventAt, createdAt and updatedAt.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
